question: According to the census of India 2011, select the Union Territory that had less than 1 lakh population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• According to the Census of India 2011, Lakshadweep had a population of approximately **64,473**.
 
• It is the smallest Union Territory of India in terms of population.
 
• The archipelago consists of 36 islands in the Arabian Sea, out of which only 10 are inhabited.
